description.value: Gaya Korean Restaurant is an authentic Korean eatery on Rumble Street in Burnaby, serving a broad menu of traditional dishes including bibimbap, bulgogi, tteokbokki, gamjatang, and yangnyeom fried chicken. The restaurant has attracted a loyal local following for its food quality and attentive service, with online ordering available for cyclists wanting a quick stop. It sits in a residential-commercial neighbourhood and is one of the few Korean options in this part of Burnaby.
